# NRS Risk Management Portal

> Nigeria Revenue Service enterprise risk management portal for risk identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring. ISO 31000 compliant, powered by RiskRadar.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Risk Management Portal and quick access to modules.
- [Help Center & FAQ](/help): Frequently asked questions covering risk register, matrix, dashboard, BCP, and forum usage.
- [Documentation](/docs): Role-based user guides, permissions matrix, and reference material.
- [Submit a Whistleblow Report](/whistleblow/submit): Anonymous incident reporting portal — no login required.
- [Check Case Status](/whistleblow/follow-up): Follow up on a submitted whistleblow report using a case reference and passphrase.
